about: Shrink-only baseline for chaingraph/standard/jcs-rfc8785-vectors.test.mjs (JCS-RFC8785-VECTORS-1). Every non-PASS (implementation, case) outcome is listed with its class. defect: to be removed by the owner row when fixed. policy: a deliberate I-JSON rule (SPEC §4 / §PPH-1.1: unsafe integers fail loudly). by-design: the twin mirrors the zkVM guest's journal serializer; aligning it needs a new guest image and re-proving, which is not planned. Never add an entry to make the gate pass; fix the cause or record a ruling.

known.why: 1E30 is an integer-valued double above 2^53; assertIJson rejects it by design
fail-closed on exponent-form numbers, mirroring the guest
